name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or unexpected behavior in Kiro-Claude-Bridge
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
---

### Environment
- OS: (e.g. Windows 11, macOS 15, Ubuntu 24.04)
- Node.js Version (`node -v`): (or Portable Release Bundle)
- Launch Method: (e.g. root `start-web.bat`, `scripts/start-web.bat`, `npm run web`, `./start.sh`)
- Kiro IDE Login Method: (Google / GitHub Social / AWS IdC)

### Describe the Bug
A clear description of what happened vs. what you expected.

### Diagnostics / Terminal Output
Paste terminal logs or Web Dashboard status/logs here (please redact any tokens or personal paths).

### Checklist
- [ ] I ran `npm test` (if running from source)
- [ ] I checked whether another process is holding port `3456` / `3457`
